title: tracker interface (config tracker, adapters, the entries its commands print)
description: The tracker is the project's own system, reached through the operations the harness calls: ready, show, list, claim, close, reopen. An adapter (adapters/<name>.json, or a path in the config) maps each to a shell command and says where each entry field is in the JSON the command prints. With no tracker.adapter there is no tracker: bricks.json is the work list.

ref.description: The tracker's own id of the entry.

assignee.description: The claim holder, when the tracker keeps one.

deps.description: Refs of the entries that block this one.

field.description: Where an entry field is in the tracker's JSON: a path (a.b, a[].b maps a list, a[k=v].b filters a list).

config.description: The config's tracker object. Nothing is hard-coded; absent means no tracker.

adapter.description: An adapter name (adapters/<name>.json) or a path to an adapter file, relative to the project root.

goal.description: Ref of the goal admission takes items from (ready(parent=goal)).

actor.description: The name the harness acts as in the tracker. Default: a hash of host and clone path, never a person.

commands.description: Overrides of the adapter's commands, by operation.

sha256.description: The tracker binary's sha256 for this platform when the adapter has none for it.

repo.description: owner/name of the tracker's repository. Default: read from the git remote origin.

known_issues.description: Ref of the single Known issues list issue.

binary.description: Program on PATH whose sha256 is checked before any command runs.

types.description: The tracker's names for goal, feature, item and defect (the defect intake, admitted as a defect item under its parent).

commands.description: Operation to command template. ready and show are needed; list and claim are used when present; close and reopen are run by reconcile.

issues.description: REST issue list (state, limit): objects with id, number, created_at, labels, parent_issue_url, milestone, body

fields.description: Entry field to where it is in the tracker's JSON; an operation's own table under by_op wins.

states.description: The tracker's state names to open, in_progress, closed, deferred.

missing.description: A regular expression that the error text of a show matches when the ref no longer exists.

release.description: Command text the owner runs to free a stale claim, {ref} filled in; a fact lists it.

id_prefix.description: Prefix of the item id derived from a ref (<prefix>-<slug of the ref>).
